scope: Homogeneous orbit matching, weighted binary matrix arrays and quantitative partition approximation with compatible refinement. For type III_lambda relations the lattice probability and ergodic kernel follow under the stated modular and relation-algebra foundations. Six solved exercises distinguish set approximation from orbit exhaustion.
